description: Golden question set for the policy RAG evaluation gate. Ground truth is derived from evaluation/datasets/policy-corpus.json.

questions.question: What is the daily meal reimbursement cap per person during business travel?
questions.groundTruth: Employee meals during approved business travel are reimbursed up to 75 dollars per person per day.

questions.question: Is alcohol reimbursable on a business meal?
questions.groundTruth: Alcohol is not reimbursable under any circumstance.

questions.question: What must be recorded on a client entertainment meal line item?
questions.groundTruth: A client entertainment meal requires the names of every attendee and the business purpose recorded on the expense line item.

questions.question: At what amount does an expense line item require an itemized receipt?
questions.groundTruth: An itemized receipt is required for every expense line item of 25 dollars or more.

questions.question: How many days do employees have to upload receipts after the transaction date?
questions.groundTruth: Receipts must be uploaded within 30 days of the transaction date.

questions.question: How often may a missing receipt affidavit be submitted and who approves it?
questions.groundTruth: A missing receipt affidavit may be submitted once per quarter and requires Finance Admin approval.

questions.question: What is the personal vehicle mileage reimbursement rate per mile?
questions.groundTruth: Personal vehicle mileage is reimbursed at 67 cents per mile for the business portion of a trip.

questions.question: Is commuting mileage between home and the assigned office reimbursable?
questions.groundTruth: Commuting between home and the assigned office is never reimbursable.

questions.question: What must a mileage log record for each trip?
questions.groundTruth: Mileage logs must record the trip date, the start and end locations, and the business purpose.

questions.question: Which hotel lodging charges are not reimbursable?
questions.groundTruth: Room upgrades, minibar charges, and in-room entertainment are not reimbursable.

questions.question: What approval is needed for hotel stays longer than seven consecutive nights?
questions.groundTruth: Stays longer than seven consecutive nights require Department Manager approval before booking.

questions.question: Which fare class is reimbursable for flights under six hours of scheduled flight time?
questions.groundTruth: Economy class is the reimbursable fare class for all flights under six hours of scheduled flight time.

questions.question: When is premium economy reimbursable for a flight?
questions.groundTruth: Premium economy is reimbursable for flights of six hours or longer.

questions.question: How far before departure must flights be booked when the itinerary is known in advance?
questions.groundTruth: Flights must be booked at least fourteen days before departure whenever the itinerary is known in advance.

questions.question: At what expense line item amount is a second review flag raised?
questions.groundTruth: Any expense line item over 500 dollars is flagged for a second review by a Department Manager.

questions.question: Can a flagged line item move to AP Review before the flag is cleared?
questions.groundTruth: A flagged line item cannot move to AP Review until the flag is cleared.

questions.question: Who performs the second pair review on flagged line items above 5000 dollars?
questions.groundTruth: Finance Admin performs the second pair review on flagged line items above 5000 dollars.

questions.question: Within how many days of the earliest transaction date must an expense report be submitted?
questions.groundTruth: An expense report must be submitted within 60 days of the earliest transaction date it contains.

questions.question: Are expense reports older than 120 days reimbursable?
questions.groundTruth: Reports older than 120 days are not reimbursable.

questions.question: Are traffic fines and parking tickets reimbursable?
questions.groundTruth: Personal grooming, traffic fines, parking tickets, and travel insurance purchased separately are not reimbursable.

questions.question: Are airline seat selection fees reimbursable?
questions.groundTruth: Fees for airline seat selection are not reimbursable.

questions.question: At what amount does an expense line item require an itemized receipt?
questions.groundTruth: An itemized receipt is required for every expense line item of 10 dollars or more.

questions.question: Is mileage reimbursed for trips shorter than five miles?
questions.groundTruth: Contoso Logistics does not reimburse mileage for trips shorter than five miles.
